verdict.rationale: Superset explicitly supports cron-like 'automations' that run an agent session on a schedule, producing a live workspace for review, accessible via UI, CLI, SDK, and MCP server (superset-docs-3, -20, -8, -9, -24). This is corroborated by a live/paid feature listing and API surface (superset-docs-28, superset-probe-rt-2/3), giving strong first-party and probe-level confirmation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community confirmation specifically of the automations/scheduling feature (most community quotes focus on parallel agent sessions, not scheduling) and detail on failure/retry handling for scheduled runs.
